[SWS_DM_00227] Check for supported sessions
⌈
If the Subfunction ad-
dressed by the DiagnosticSessionControl according to [SWS_DM_00226] is not sup-
ported by the configuration, i.e., there is no DiagnosticSession configured with
id matching the requested Subfunction value, the Diagnostic Server instance
shall return a NRC 0x12 (SubfunctionNotSupported).
